question: Could you calculate the average of the total runs scored by all strikers who have scored more than 50 runs in any single match?
sql:
WITH striker_match_runs AS (
    -- Calculate total runs per striker per match
    SELECT bb.striker, bb.match_id, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as match_total_runs
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
      AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
      AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
      AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.striker, bb.match_id
),
qualifying_strikers AS (
    -- Find strikers who have at least one match with > 50 runs
    SELECT DISTINCT striker
    FROM striker_match_runs
    WHERE match_total_runs > 50
),
striker_total_runs AS (
    -- Calculate total runs for each qualifying striker across ALL matches
    SELECT q.striker, SUM(smr.match_total_runs) as total_runs
    FROM qualifying_strikers q
    JOIN striker_match_runs smr ON q.striker = smr.striker
    GROUP BY q.striker
)
SELECT AVG(total_runs) as average_total_runs
FROM striker_total_runs
